_comment: THE FIRST SATELLITE (sky world s4). BARE ROCK ON PURPOSE: it has an island
chunk and NO zone, which is the case content::Island::zone was made optional
for. Nothing is built here yet, and that is content this milestone does not
owe - what s4 owes is that an island the player does not start with can be
MODELS/ISLAND.GLTF IS THE SATELLITE RECIPE, kept deliberately when the hub
was replaced by an authored sculpt on 2026-08-28: it is parametric, 560
triangles against the hub's 7,626, and generated by model_studio rather than
pinned, so a satellite costs a registry row and a file rather than a
modelling session. Its pivot is `top_centre`, so y = 0 is the walking
surface and anything placed here sits ON it.
NO CAMERA, NO SUN, NO SKY - those are worlds/persistent.world.json and are
shared by every island (ADR-0142). NOT SCALED either: the registry's
half-extents are checked against model_contract.json's size_m, and a scale
here would make that comparison mean something else.
name: near_isle

entities._comment: The island. `casts_shadows: false` for the hub's reason — nothing is underneath it. No `color` or `roughness`: engine_spawners builds a tint material when either is present and a tint REPLACES the model's own.
